name: Forged in Battle
legend: To this Angel of Death, war is the anvil upon which their strength is wrought. Every battle is seen as a test in which they and their battle-brothers can prove themselves, and the superior craftsmanship of their weapons and armour.
description:
Adeptus Astartes model only. This unit can ignore modifiers to:
  • BS.
  • WS.
  • Hit rolls.

name: Artificer Sarcophagus
legend: Fashioned by an artificer of exceptional skill over an entire lifetime, this sarcophagus resists even the most grievous blows.
description: Dreadnought unit only. Attacks that target this unit have -1 D.

name: Martial Paragon
legend: Leading his battle-brothers by example, this champion of the Chapter strives to embody the martial teachings of the Codex Astartes.
description:
Tacticus model only. This unit’s attacks can:
  • Re-roll one hit roll.
  • Re-roll one wound roll.

name: Champion of the First Company
legend: Few are the enemies this warrior has not faced and bested, and they remember the vulnerabilities of every defeated foe.
description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. This unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

name: Master-forged Firearms
legend: The finest ballistic armaments the Chapter’s artificers can create, these weapons reap a grievous tally of foes.
description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted model only. This model’s ranged attacks (excluding [Psychic] attacks) have +1 A, S, AP and D.

name: Howlmaw
legend: An ancient hunting horn with a built-in vox amplification unit, this relic’s stirring howl can be heard even through the wild clangour of battle.
description: Wolf Priest model only. (Once per turn, per unit) At the start of the fight phase, you can select one enemy unit within 6" of this model. That unit makes a battle-shock roll with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

name: The Thief of Secrets
legend: The Thief of Secrets is a blade whose machine spirit has an unquenchable thirst for knowledge. It has tasted the vitae of countless alien races, absorbing those liquids through auto-sanctified sanguinator-channels and codifying them through the honeycombed array of logicum cells within. The biological secrets of many xenos races have thus been laid bare, allowing the blade’s user to modulate its power field, the better to slice through chitinous armour, rupture xenoform organs and burn out alien nervous systems.
description: WATCH MASTER/CAPTAIN model only. This model has the following weapon:

name: Beacon Angelis
legend: The Beacon Angelis was devised to guide the Deathwatch to the threshold of the alien adversary. Housed within a reliquary, it calls out to the warriors’ augur arrays with the voices of a hundred electric cherubim, its summons so strong that it draws the righteous unto its locale regardless of what darkness may surround it.
description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. If this unit is a Kill Team unit, this unit has:
  • Deep Strike.
  • When you target this unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, that use is -1CP.

name: Hunter's Guile
legend: Adeptus Astartes model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

name: Student of the Codex
legend: This prodigal officer has focused upon one aspect of the Codex Astartes and means to master its every aspect before moving on to the next.
description: Captain model only. The tactical doctrine is active for this unit <u>in addition</u> to any other combat doctrine.

name: Honour Indefatigable
legend: This rare honour badge celebrates a warrior who refuses to give up, even in the face of apparently certain death.
description:
Gravis model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6:
  • On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

name: Redoubtable Machine Spirit
legend: This ancient war machine has endured millennia of battle, and its belligerent machine spirit has only become more obdurant.
description:
Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit only (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units). This unit:
  • Has 5+ InSv.
  • At the end of your Command phase, heals 1 wound.

name: Blackwing Shroud
legend: This mechanical device contains miniaturised refraction fields and electromagnetic interference projectors that distort sensory apparatus, enabling the bearer and their unit to evade detection and infiltrate key positions.
description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. This unit has Infiltrators.

name: Standard of the Emperor Ascendant
legend: This venerable banner was carried in the Great Crusade, and its presence is a constant inspiration.
description:
Ancient model only. This model has:
  • +1 OC and Ld.
  • Feel No Pain 5+.
  • The following ability:

    Ancient Exhortation (Once per battle, per army): When this unit is selected to fight, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit’s melee attacks have +1 A until the end of the phase.

name: Preyslayer
legend: Possessed of a ferocious predatory instinct, this warrior leads swift and deadly encirclements and ambushes with peerless skill.
description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. This unit can re-roll charge rolls.

name: Adamantine Mantle
legend: Bestowed as a mark of honour, this venerated relic lends an extra layer of armour protection that proves especially useful amidst vicious void war.
description: Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

name: Linebreaker Onslaught
legend: These battle-brothers excel in bursting from the cover of their transport and straight into the enemy lines.
description:
Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. If this unit disembarked this turn:
  • This unit can re-roll charge rolls.
  • Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

name: Immovable Conquerors
legend: Once these Gravis-armoured warriors have planted their feet and braced for battle, no force in the galaxy can move them.
description: Gravis unit only. This unit has +1 OC.

name: Cyber-familiar
legend: Hovering high overhead on grav-impellers, this small cyber-creature cogitates emergent threats and alerts its master to tactical openings.
description: Tacticus model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

name: Target Augury Web
legend: This spearhead commander uses advanced augmetics to distribute targeting data. With these, they direct the fire of their war engine crews and rouse their machine spirits to operative superiority.
description: TECHMARINE model only. In your movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 3" of this unit. That VEHICLE model’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS] until the start of your next Command phase

name: Supercharged Engines
legend: Built from ancient and dimly understood designs, these engines generate incredible power and torque.
description: Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit only. This unit can re-roll advance rolls.

name: Laurels of Vigilance
legend: Those awarded this prestigious honour are ever vigilant, responding swiftly and with measured force to enemy threats.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only.(Once per battle round, per army) When you use the Fire Overwatch/Heroic Intervention stratagem, if you target a friendly Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit within 12" of this model with that stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

name: Indefatigable Fortitude
legend: Renowned for being a living engine of war, this warrior inspires his comrades to shrug off even the most devastating attacks.
description: Gravis model only. Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

name: Singular Will
legend: This warrior lets nothing stand in their way or slow their advance, closing swiftly and relentlessly with their quarry.
description: Deathwing model only. When this unit is selected to make a consolidation move, this unit can move up to D3+3".

name: Omni-Structural Auspex
legend: A rare device with a potent and knowledgeable machine spirit, this implement analyses the integrity of foes’ armour and isolates weaknesses to exploit.
description: In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES model (excluding Character models) makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
legend: A veteran of the Inner Circle, this warrior inspires those around them to hold the line amidst the heat and chaos of battle.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6" of this model can re-roll leadership rolls.

name: Speartip of the Chapter
legend: A veteran of countless boarding strikes, this warrior leads their battle-brothers in a vanguard breach that drives into the foe's heart.
description: At the start of the first battle round, the bearer’s unit and up to one other friendly unit within the same Entry Zone can each make a Normal move of up to 6".

name: Imperium's Sword
legend: This champion hurls himself forwards with unbridled ferocity, cutting down the foe like a reaping whirlwind.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model has the following weapon:

name: Seal of Shrouding
legend: Built into what appears a simple wax purity seal, this device scrambles enemy targeting when the bearer is on the move.
description: Phobos model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

name: Thundercowl Turbines
legend: These master-wrought engines from the Dark Ages of Technology churn the gloom emanated by the Ravenwing's reliquaries into a billowing cawl that shrouds their advance, allowing them to strike when the foe least expects.
description: Ravenwing Fly/Ravenwing Mounted unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

name: Seal of Indomitability
legend: This ancient honour is said to fortify the machine spirit of a suit of Terminator plate against even the most dolorous of blows.
description: Once per battle, when the bearer’s unit is selected as the target of one or more attacks, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has a 3+ invulnerable save.

name: Venator Omni-auspex
legend: Constantly detecting and analysing viable targets, this artefact feeds advanced combat data directly into the bearer’s autosenses.
description:
Phobos model only. This unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit can:
  • Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
  • Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2.

name: Instinctive Interception
legend: Proudly is Sanguinius remembered for his rapid intercession in the protection of his gene-sons. Driven on by death visions, this lost warrior is a tragic monument to such glory.
description: Death Company model only. When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

name: Shadow of Abomination
legend: Granted a glimmer of foresight by his genetic inheritance, this Son of Sanguinius has identified a foe whose future is drenched in the blood of the Imperium. Such an enemy cannot be allowed to live.
description: Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack model only. (once per battle, per army) When this unit is selected to fight you can use this ability. If you do, this model’s melee attacks have +1 D.

name: Prescient Flash
legend: A flash of foresight and clarity sings through this warrior’s blood and guides his steps into battle.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit has Scouts 6".

name: Augury Servo-host
legend: This warrior’s auto-senses are linked to a circling host of servo-skulls crafted from the remains of favoured serfs and failed neophytes. Fitted with ocular probes and sensor vanes, they provide the Black Templar with advanced targeting information to pick out the unbelievers who cower in concealment.
description: Adeptus Astartes model only. In your Shooting phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit. That enemy unit cannot have the benefit of cover.

name: Fervent Exemplars
legend: Paragons of their crusade's inexorable wrath, these Sword Brethren have earned a reputation for carving a path to victory through their foes, unable to rest while one enemy yet lives.
description: Sword Brethren Squad unit only. This unit has +1 to charge rolls.

name: Righteous Fervour
legend: With their zealous hatred stoked red-hot by furious sermons and inflammatory prayers, Companions of Vehemence are filled with a wrathful vigour. Only the deaths of the God-Emperor’s enemies can assuage their fury, and they will let nothing delay them from unleashing it.
description: CRUSADER SQUAD unit only. This unit can re-roll Advance rolls.

name: Stormseer's Wisdom
legend: The Chapter’s Librarians have made this champion privy to omens of great threats in future wars. Armed with this knowledge, they lead their warriors to war with a boldness that some mistake for recklessness.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit can re-roll advance rolls.

name: Auspex Triangulation Shrines
legend: Fitted to the Chapter’s swift grav-speeders, these vigilant devices runelock the positions of enemy forces, laying them bare to the Space Marines’ wrath.
description:
Adeptus Astartes speeder unit only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit is spotted:
  • While a unit is spotted, that unit has +3" detection range.

name: Inheritors of Sigismund
legend: These warrior elites have achieved feats of bloody slaughter against the most deadly of the God-Emperor's foes, executing them in displays of such blisteringly swift attacks that it is clear they share a sliver of Sigismund's own skill.
description: Sword Brethren Squad unit only. This unit has Fights First.

name: Tactical Insight
legend: This champion understands the deeper flow of battle, and is always prepared to discern the course of action that will bring assured victory.
description: Captain model only. The tactical doctrine is active for this unit <u>in addition</u> to any other combat doctrine.

name: Oathbound Exemplar
legend: With a ceaseless and booming oratory, this commander exhorts his warriors in their duty to the Emperor. Honour, he declaims, must be pursued relentlessly.
description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit only. When this unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move, that advance/fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.

name: Narthecis Gauntlet
legend: This rare supplementary medicae suite allows this Apothecary to provide support to their battle-brothers despite being outfitted for a different role.
description: Apothecary Biologis model only. in your Command phase, this unit heals D3+1 wounds.

name: Beacon Angelis
legend: The Beacon Angelis was devised to guide the Deathwatch to the threshold of the alien adversary. Housed within a reliquary, it calls out to the warriors’ augur arrays with the voices of a hundred electric cherubim, its summons so strong that it draws the righteous unto its locale regardless of what darkness may surround it.
description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. If this unit is a Kill Team unit, this unit has:
  • Deep Strike.
  • When you target this unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, that use is -1CP.

name: Chogorian Huntmaster
legend: This mounted huntsman knows well the importance of manoeuvre, outflanking the enemy and ambushing unsuspecting foes from the flanks and rear, the better to land the killing blow.
description: Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit only. When this unit is selected to make an ingress move, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

name: Angelic Executioner
legend: This deadly duellist leads his battle-brothers in masterful strikes capable of carving through their armoured or swarming foes with breathtaking fluidity.
description:
Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack model only. When this unit is selected to fight, this unit’s melee attacks have:
  • [LETHAL HITS].
  • Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1]

name: Adamantine Mantle
legend: This flowing cloak or finely wrought tabard is laced through with threads of braided adamantine. When combined with armour and energy fields, it has been shown time and again that these symbols of office are proof against even the very strongest attacks.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Attacks allocated to this model have -1 D.

name: Lord of the Ravenwing
legend: This commander has mastered the art of cavalry combat, instinctively noticing the opportune position to strike and navigating the chaos of battle with preternatural precision.
description: Ravenwing model only. This unit can re-roll charge rolls.

name: A Giant Amongst Giants
legend: Likened to a walking pinnacle of Fenrisian granite come to life, this hulking champion is an echo of Russ himself.
description:
Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only.
  • This model has +2 W.
  • This model’s melee attacks have +1 S.

name: Furious Assault
legend: Bellicose temperament and advanced training combine to make this unit especially terrifying on the charge.
description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit only. This unit’s melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].

name: Adept of the Omnissiah
legend: This battle-brother is steeped in hidden technological rites. Should their armoured charges be threatened, a burst of arcane Binharic screed can rouse their machine spirits to vigilance.
description: TECHMARINE model only. (Once per battle round, per army) When an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 6" of this unit, you can use this ability. If you do, that VEHICLE unit has Feel No Pain 5+ until that enemy unit has attacked.

name: Spearpoint War Leader
legend: Once the enemy are sighted, this warrior leads the attack from the very front, striving to be first in amongst the foe’s ranks.
description: Tacticus model only. This unit has Scouts 6".

name: Execute and Redeploy
legend: This war leader excels in harrying tactics, wielding their strike force like a weapon of utmost stealth and cunning.
description: Phobos model only. In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of up to 6". If it does, this unit is <u>not</u> eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

name: Corporeum Reliquary
legend: This archeotech teleportation stabiliser is unique, a relic of Dark Age technology that spirits its bearer swiftly through the tides of the Warp.
description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

name: On the Archtraitor's Bridge
legend: Lost to a memory shard of the Primarch, in this warrior's mind, he has entered the Archtraitor's sanctum, and all that stands between him and Horus is a host of massing traitors.
description: Death Company model only. This model’s melee attacks have +2 A.

name: Honour of Vigilance
legend: A savant of applied firepower, this warrior ensures their comrades’ big guns are always optimally positioned and targeted.
description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only.
  • This unit’s ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits].
  • If the devastator doctrine is active for this unit, this unit can re-roll advance rolls.

name: Relentless Advance
legend: Ever on the move, this warrior leads his battle-brothers in a tireless crusade across the battlefields of the 41st millennium.
description: Gravis model only. This unit has Scouts 5".

name: Umbral Raptor
legend: This warrior is a solitary predator whose footsteps are all but silent and whose form is one with the shadows.
description:
Adeptus Astartes infantry model only. This model has:
  • Fights First.
  • Lone Operative.

name: Champion of the Deathwing
legend: Even amongst the elite of the Unforgiven, this warrior is a paragon of duty and martial might.
description: Deathwing model only. This unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within range of your vowed objective have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

name: Nightforged Battery
legend: Use of these relic plasma storm batteries is granted only by dispensation of the Master of the Rock. They unleash devastating toroids of searing plasma, while their venting subsystems are known to be especially vigilant.
description:
Land Speeder Vengeance unit only. This unit can re-roll:
  • Rolls to determine the A of a weapon.
  • Hazard rolls.

name: Blazing Icon
legend: What was before merely a decorative blood drop pendant now shines with a seemingly miraculous light as bright as any star. The foe are forced to avert their gaze from its wrathful magnificence.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.

name: Clavitine Reliquary
legend: A timeless and unique example of Chapter artifice, this device rapidly synchronises with the data spirits of locking devices and renders them quiescent.
description: In your Movement phase, each time the bearer is selected to make a Normal or Advance move, if it is within 1" of a Hatchway, it can attempt to operate that Hatchway. If it does, it cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again this turn.

name: Consecrating Aura
legend: The piety and honour of this warrior can be felt wherever he fights. His presence rouses the ardent souls of the Black Templars, warding Sigismund’s heirs from the blasphemy of the unbeliever.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit has 5+ InSv.

name: Gunnery Honours
legend: The crew of this war machine demonstrate exemplary gunnery and have earned the highest honours for their craft.
description: Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit only (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units). This unit’s ranged attacks have [Heavy].

name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
legend: The stonewrought reputation and unfaltering determination of this commander serve as a linchpin for even the most hard-pressed strike force.
description: Tacticus model only. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6" of this model can re-roll leadership rolls.

name: Venator Omni-auspex
legend: Constantly detecting and analysing viable targets, this artefact feeds advanced combat data directly into the bearer’s autosenses.
description:
Phobos model only. This unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit can:
  • Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
  • Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls of 1-2.

name: Wolf-Touched
legend: Whilst the Canis Helix has yet to overcome this champion fully, it is stirred to life by the thrill of battle and the scent of blood.
description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit has:
  • Wulfen.
  • +2" M.
support_leader: LEADER: WULFEN WITH STORM SHIELDS, WULFEN

name: Resolute
legend: Allowing nothing to bar his path, this champion of the Chapter ploughs a bloody path through the foe.
description: The bearer is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. In addition, Desperate Escape tests taken for the bearer are automatically passed, and each time the bearer makes a Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models as if they were not there.

name: Damocles-class Uplink
legend: This portable strat-shrine plugs directly into the bearer’s armour, enhancing their command and control abilities.
description: Captain model only. In your Movement phase, if this unit is embarked within a Transport unit, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit within 6" of that TRANSPORT unit and select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for that INFANTRY unit.

name: Void Warrior
legend: Having mastered the arts of shipboard warfare over many battles, this warrior moves swiftly through them and strikes with unerring skill.
description: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer. In addition, the bearer is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Venerable Champion (Aura)
legend: Having won innumerable triumphs, this timeless warrior confers the boon of their martial wisdom upon their battle-brothers.
description: Dreadnought unit only. While a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

name: Castellum Omnivox
legend: This unique vox-and-augur augmetic provides the bearer with unparalleled tactical data vital to coordinating an aggressive defence in battle.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit only. When this unit makes a advance/fall-back move, that move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.

name: Laurels of Triumph
legend: A rare honour, the Laurels of Triumph mark out a truly accomplished warrior even amongst the Angels of Death.
description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have:
  • +1 S and AP.
  • Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, +2 S and AP.

name: Tolorek Data Djinn
legend: Gifted by the Tech-Priests of Tolorek for the cleansing of Ultramar, this powerful cyberspirit uses brute force technoscreed when entreated to overwhelm the systems of enemy ships, conquering them and yoking their protocols to the bearer's will.
description: In your Command phase, select one objective marker that you control and is within range of the bearer. Roll one D6: on a 2+, that objective marker is Secured by your army.

name: Grimnar's Mark
legend: This moonsilver wolf-talisman is bestowed by the Great Wolf himself before battle, a mark of favour that fills the bearer with an eagerness to slay the foe.
description:
Adeptus Astartes Terminator Captain model only. (Once per battle round, per army) You can target this unit with the Rapid Ingress/Heroic Intervention stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do:
  • That use is -1CP.
  • That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

name: Armour of Antoninus
legend: Originally worn by a storied Captain of the Ultramarines’ First Company, this artificer armour is bestowed by the Chapter Master himself upon a worthy wearer.
description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model has:
  • 2+ Sv.
  • Feel No Pain 5+.

name: Hunter's Eye
legend: This augmetic eye enhances the user’s visual spectrum, enabling them to pinpoint heat signatures and cogitate appropriate firing solutions.
description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit’s ranged attacks:
  • Have [IGNORES COVER].
  • Have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

name: Adept of the Codex
legend: An ardent student of the Codex Astartes, this commander epitomises its tactical genius.
description: Captain model only. The tactical doctrine is active for this unit <u>in addition</u> to any other combat doctrine.

name: Hunter's Instincts
legend: Those who master the Path of Ambush guide their forces to launch surprise assaults on the enemy with the precise timing of true hunters.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

name: Deathwing Assault
legend: A veteran inductee of the Inner Circle, this champion has served amongst the Deathwing for centuries and become an unmatched master of teleportarium insertions.
description: Deathwing model with the Deep Strike ability only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

name: Chariots of the Storm
legend: This dedicated flight of gunships attends the Great Wolf and his packs, and can be called in to rapidly reposition his forces in the moments before battle is joined.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

name: Defensive Mastery
legend: Few officers of the Chapter can match this commander’s talent for cunning defensive troop dispositions.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

name: Incendiary Animus
legend: This inspirational warrior exudes fierce contempt and loathing for the Emperor’s foes, inciting such apoplectic revulsion in their battle-brothers as to drive their blows with vicious strength.
description: Chaplain/Judiciar model only. This unit’s melee attacks have +1 S.

name: Oath of Macragge
legend: Amongst the most solemn and binding oaths an Ultramarine can swear, it is a rare honour to enter battle with these words affixed to their armour.
description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have:
  • +1 S and AP.
  • Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, +2 S and AP.

name: The Tome of Ectoclades
legend: This grimoire, bound in the skin of the alien, holds the most powerful truths the Deathwatch have uncovered about their foes - whether xenos or those who harbour them - arming them with the best tactics and strategies to use against such threats.
description: WATCH MASTER/CAPTAIN model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, the assault doctrine, devastator doctrine and tactical doctrine are active for this unit until the start of your next Command phase.

name: War Tempered Artifice
legend: Having laboured long in the Chapter’s forges, this warrior smith has crafted his personal armaments. Each weapon is a masterwork tool of death-dealing, wrought with care and strength, and embellished with the icons of their maker’s brotherhood.
description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have:
  • +1 S.
  • +1 D.

name: Ordained Sacrifice
legend: Knowing only too well the desperate and vital nature of the battle before him, this scion of Sanguinius echoes his Primarch’s resolute determination to fight on even beyond what seems the doors of certain death.
description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6:
  • On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

name: Master of the Machine War
legend: This commander is supremely gifted in the strategies of armoured warfare, understanding the capabilities of every war engine in the Chapter’s arsenal. Delivering precision orders, they ensure the vehicles under their command inflict the most punishing damage to the

name: Coronal Susurrant
legend: This wreath of circuitry from the Dark Age of Technology forces a whispering white noise into enemy minds and broadcasts, impeding communications and interrupting the chain of command.
description: Phobos model only. Each enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) engaged with this unit cannot be targeted by controlling player stratagems.

name: Spy-skull Data Link
legend: Several artificer-crafted and heavily shrouded servo-skulls are tethered to this device, their linked visual feeds making the bearer nigh impossible to evade.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit only. This unit’s ranged weapons have [IGNORES COVER].

name: Spearpoint Paragon
legend: Decades of service within the White Scars First Company have helped this superlative warrior master the violent arts of high-speed combat.
description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have:
  • +1 S and AP.
  • Or: If this unit made a charge move this turn, +2 S and AP.

name: Immolator
legend: Steeped in the Promethean Cult, this battle-brother wields the flamer with unparalleled mastery, turning the battlefield into a burning pyre for the corpses of his foes.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit’s [TORRENT] weapons have +1 A.

name: Veteran of Behemoth
legend: Having battled the Tyranid swarms since their first galactic invasion, this veteran officer knows well the benefit of efficient and overwhelming firepower.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

name: Osseus Key (Aura)
legend: The ancient clavis known as the Osseus Key is said to be the most powerful of its kind. Where other such devices are made from sanctified platinum, the Osseus Key is made from the hand and finger bones of deceased Imperial Fists heroes that fought in the Horus Heresy, scrimshawed with inhuman care and imbued with the fiercest machine spirits of the age. No portal can bar its bearer from entry, and no xenos machine can stand before his wrath.
description: WATCH MASTER/TECHMARINE model only. While an enemy VEHICLE unit is within 6" of this model, that enemy unit’s attacks have -1 A.

name: Skjald's Foretelling
legend: Great deeds have been prophesied for this champion, such that those who fight alongside him do so all the harder as they play out the self-fulfilling prophecy.
description: Wolf Guard Battle Leader model only. This unit’s melee attacks have [Lance].

name: Ancient Weapons
legend: The vaults of the Dark Angels contain many relics from Humanity’s distant past. This soldier has been granted the honour of bearing such a weapon to battle.
description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks:
  • Have +2 S.
  • Have +1 AP.

name: Artificer Armour
legend: Crafted by the Chapter’s finest artificers, this suit of armour provides superior protection.
description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model has:
  • 2+ Sv.
  • Feel No Pain 5+.

name: The Flesh is Weak
legend: The injuries of past battles have seen this warrior heavily rebuilt with ultra-durable cybernetic limbs and organs that render them extremely difficult to kill.
description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model:
  • Has +1 T.
  • Has Feel No Pain 5+.

name: Unto Death
legend: Just as his Primarch before him, this warrior has foreseen his impending doom and goes towards it regardless, desperate to land a telling blow upon the foe before death claims him.
description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. (Once per battle, per army) In your Command phase you can use this ability. If you do, until the end of the turn this unit can:
  • Re-roll advance rolls.
  • Re-roll charge rolls.

name: Zealous Vanguard
legend: This warrior is an unstoppable crusader whose hearts burn like twin pyres of eager zeal. Ever at the forefront of combat, he leads his warriors as the tip of the crusade’s blade.
description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit has Scouts 6".
